from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(f"- {line}", font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 1.0 + j * 1.0  # Shifted right to accommodate lecture text
                y = 2.2 - i * 1.0
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            'Meet the five most important constants in mathematics.',
            'Zero, one, pi, e, and the imaginary unit i.',
            'They seem unrelated, coming from completely different worlds.',
            'But Euler found a beautiful bridge connecting them all.',
            'Welcome to the journey of the complex plane.'
        ]
        self.setup_layout("The Grand Reunion", lecture_lines)

        # Define colors
        color_e = "#00FF00"
        color_i = "#00FFFF"
        color_pi = "#FF8800"
        color_1 = "#FFFF00"
        color_0 = "#FFFFFF"

        # Create constants

        const_i = Text("i", color=color_i, font_size=60)

        const_1 = Text("1", color=color_1, font_size=60)
        const_0 = Text("0", color=color_0, font_size=60)

        constants = VGroup(const_e, const_i, const_pi, const_1, const_0)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===

        # Initial scattered positions

        self.place_at_grid(const_i, 'B5')
        self.place_at_grid(const_pi, 'E2')
        self.place_at_grid(const_1, 'E5')
        self.place_at_grid(const_0, 'C3')
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(const_e), FadeIn(const_i), FadeIn(const_pi), 
            FadeIn(const_1), FadeIn(const_0),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(color_i)
        )
        
        # Highlight sequence
        for obj in [const_0, const_1, const_pi, const_e, const_i]:
            self.play(obj.animate.scale(1.2), run_time=0.3)
            self.play(obj.animate.scale(1/1.2), run_time=0.3)
        
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(color_pi)
        )
        
        # Move to circular cluster around C4/D4
        cluster_positions = [
            self.grid['C4'] + UP * 0.5,
            self.grid['C4'] + RIGHT * 0.5 + DOWN * 0.2,
            self.grid['D4'] + LEFT * 0.5,
            self.grid['D4'] + RIGHT * 0.5,
            self.grid['C3'] + DOWN * 0.5
        ]
        
        self.play(
            const_e.animate.move_to(cluster_positions[0]),
            const_i.animate.move_to(cluster_positions[1]),
            const_pi.animate.move_to(cluster_positions[2]),
            const_1.animate.move_to(cluster_positions[3]),
            const_0.animate.move_to(cluster_positions[4]),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.play(
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(color_1)
        )
        
        # Create faint lines of light (bridge)
        bridge_lines = VGroup()
        for i in range(len(constants)):
            for j in range(i + 1, len(constants)):
                line = Line(
                    constants[i].get_center(), 
                    constants[j].get_center(), 
                    stroke_width=1, 
                    stroke_opacity=0.4,
                    color=WHITE
                )
                bridge_lines.add(line)
        
        self.play(Create(bridge_lines), run_time=2)
        self.play(bridge_lines.animate.set_stroke(opacity=0.7, width=2), run_time=1)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.play(
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[4].animate.set_color(color_i)
        )
        
        # Final section pose with light pulse
        self.play(
            Indicate(constants, color=WHITE, scale_factor=1.05),
            bridge_lines.animate.set_color(color_i),
            run_time=2
        )
